name: io.github.atomno-mcp/mcp-erid
title: mcp-erid
description: Erid format check; ORD cabinet lookup on the client key.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ERID_ORD_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: API key from the client's ORD cabinet (VK documented).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ERID_ORD_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: ORD operator id. Currently vk. yandex lookup spec is not public.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ERID_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional key for Atomno hosted placement. Not an ORD key.
